narrative.northStar: The Clear Desk (with Support Beacon accents)
narrative.overview:
Enki is a modern, usable internal support messenger on a calm white plane. The Clear Desk leads: screens stay light, sparse, and scannable so Contacts, Agents, and Admins can finish a job without chrome noise. Enki Blue appears when it means action, selection, or “you” (primary buttons, selected chips, outgoing bubbles, avatar initials on Beacon Mist). Beacon Mist is the soft help wash — selected states and soft chips — not a second brand color fighting Graphite type.

Personality is friendly and direct: soft full pills, rounded cards, tactile press, no theatrical gradients. Depth is hybrid — hairline line borders at rest; soft card shadows for hub/inbox rows; stronger shadow only for overlays (reaction tray, attachment sheet). This phase locks light chrome only; dark tokens exist in CSS for later but must not drive UI now.
keyCharacteristics: White Clear Desk surfaces; Graphite type; Enki Blue as the sparse action/help signal
Manrope for UI; JetBrains Mono for code-like fragments only
Soft rounded cards (~24px) and chat bubbles (~22px); pills are fully round
Hybrid elevation: border-first, shadow for lift and overlays
Role clarity via uppercase eyebrows (SUPPORT / AGENT / ADMIN), not per-role palettes

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Enki Blue occupies a small share of any screen. If blue is everywhere, the Clear Desk failed.

rules.name: The Light Chrome Rule
rules.body: Ship light appearance only this phase. Do not follow system dark mode for app chrome.

rules.name: The No Hex Escape Rule
rules.body: Palette colors come from Uniwind tokens or lib/tokens.ts hex for native headers/tabs/icons — never one-off bg-[#…] for palette roles.

rules.name: The Weight Face Rule
rules.body: Use font-medium / font-semibold / font-bold utilities so Manrope faces resolve correctly on native.

rules.name: The Role Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: Role labels are uppercase labels in the greeting block, never competing with the Enki header wordmark.

rules.name: The Safe Desk Rule
rules.body: Content stays inside safe areas; Android edge-to-edge + inset padding is mandatory — do not invent a second status-bar stack.

rules.name: The Hybrid Lift Rule
rules.body: Borders define resting structure; shadows appear for stacked cards and floating overlays — not as default decoration on every view.

rules.name: The Soft Continuity Rule
rules.body: Prefer the shared radius steps; do not mix sharp cards with pill everything on the same surface without reason.

dos: Do keep the Clear Desk: white Bg/Surface, Graphite type, Enki Blue as sparse signal.
Do use Beacon Mist for soft selected/avatar/secondary moments.
Do put SUPPORT / AGENT / ADMIN in the greeting block; brand the header as Enki only.
Do use hybrid elevation — line at rest, stronger shadow on overlays.
Do honor reduced-motion paths for animated transitions.
Do add new colors to @theme and both @variant light and @variant dark when extending tokens.
donts: Don't invent palette hex via arbitrary classes when a token exists.
Don't ship Messenger-dark chrome, nsave maroon, or red outgoing bubbles.
Don't build stories, case-status steppers, or Casewire branding.
Don't put role labels in the header wordmark or theme whole hubs per role color.
Don't enable system dark mode for app chrome this phase.
Don't treat Offers as an ad SDK, checkout, or Instagram stories surface.
